Great example of the 'oh if only they went to the doctor in time' ... When they did several times...

Prescription wrong for months, nobody reads the notes, even after seeing GP specifically to sort it out it hasn't changed, paying over double for my prescriptions.

Consultant writes to GP requesting advice/coordination before I begin potentially permanently damaging treatments, GP doesn't read letter, I flag it in appointment, GP is just like oh so what? Another NHS agency referral responds to GP I need a referral (one I was told isn't procedurally possible, which the Gateshead team confirmed is false). GP didn't read letter, and when asked about it said nah not worth the bother and refused. Well thanks for consulting me and the (actually qualified, hence referral to them in the first place) Gateshead team.

Coming on 5 years the limited mobility and chronic pain that will go away in a couple weeks has been going too.
